findings.description: AWS access and secret keys are embedded directly in the Lambda function's environment variables as literal strings, so credentials are stored in source control, Terraform state, and the function configuration in plaintext. Anyone with read access to the repository, state backend, or the Lambda console/API can retrieve long-lived AWS credentials.

The function uses runtime "nodejs12.x", which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches from AWS. Running unpatched runtimes exposes the function to known vulnerabilities in the language runtime and its bundled libraries.
